dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Have you made any progress in your investigation into the meteorite strike yet? You'll get to the bottom of it. I'm sure of it.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: The victims will probably be ravenous when they do eventually wake up, won't they? So, I'd better start preparing some meals for them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That smells great...

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Haha, of course. This steak was made by me, Brook, after all!

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: I can say with confidence that I make the best steaks in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Have you tried some before? If you haven't, you can get a sample now.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Don't be shy. This is flavor that will revolutionize your taste buds!

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Hi, did the beautiful fragrance of my cooking entice you over here? Hehehe.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: You don't know who I am? I'm Brook. My meat-based recipes are very well known in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: If you want the absolutely freshest meat possible, it has to go straight from the hunt to the kitchen with not a moment wasted.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: That's the reason I moved to Springvale.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Of course, I do sell the vast majority of my cooking...

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: But the single freshest piece of meat in the day? I normally keep it as a treat for myself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Bon appétit... I mean, goodbye!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I would like to buy something to eat.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Sure thing. How about a fresh steak? There's nothing better in all of Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We meet again!

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Hey, aren't you the assistant for Xiangling, the chef from Liyue?

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: You couldn't possibly be here by coincidence. I've got it! She must want to challenge me again. I am "Mondstadt's Rotisseur Queen," after all.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Oh... That's not it, huh? Well seeing as she already beat me last time, I guess challenging me again wouldn't prove much.
